_comment: The posting queue. One clip a day, to Instagram and the Facebook Page.
Editing this file IS the sign-off step — nothing posts that isn't listed here,
and anything listed can be removed or moved right up until its date.
Dates and order are matched to what is already scheduled on TikTok, so all
three platforms carry the same clip on the same day. Change one, change TikTok.
21 Sept: myth cards 23-forgetting-curve and 24-it-felt-easy removed — the
statement-card format held 2.04s average watch against 5.25–5.30s for the games.
Batch 4 moved forward to 22 Sept because those clips carry Max's voiceover;
the batch 3 clips are silent and alternate with them as the control.
21 Sept, later: 22-sleep removed and the run pulled forward to start today, so
TikTok and Meta stay aligned. Voiced batch 4 alternates with voiced batch 3.

posts.caption:
Six people who learned in six completely different ways. One of them learns the way you do.

da Vinci filled thousands of notebooks and finished almost nothing he started. Nightingale counted every death on the ward and drew the chart that changed medicine. Mozart heard a piece once, aged fourteen, and wrote the whole thing out from memory. Darwin said he had no great quickness of apprehension - then spent twenty years on one idea.

The quiz works out which one you are, and the teaching adapts to it. Link in bio.

#learningstyles #studytok #psychology #learning #neuroscience

Most people tap out at 6. Comment the highest you managed — I want to know if anyone clears 8 🧠

#memorytest #workingmemory #studytok #brainteaser #psychology
